heading: Without `dynamic_ttl`
text:
### Without `dynamic_ttl` [LDTL.6.1]

- The facts one tick expires leave by deadline, earliest first, and facts
  that share a deadline by when each entered working memory ([LDET.5.11]).
  Within one schema that is assertion order. The order in which the schemas
  are visited does not affect it.
- The tick's cost is [LDTL.6.4]'s.

idris.name: iret_19_5__tick_clocked
idris.note: The sweep inside the tick retracts expired facts one at a time in Rete/NetworkTtl.idr's `ldtl_6_1__order`: the clause's set, in the clause's order.

idris.name: ldtl_6_1__deadline_of
idris.note: An id's deadline, from its row of the deadline table. The sweep orders only ids the table holds.

idris.name: ldtl_6_1__insert
idris.note: Insert an id ahead of every id whose deadline is the same or later: deadline order kept, and an id ahead of another with the same deadline stays ahead of it.

idris.name: ldtl_6_1__insert_fwd
idris.note: What inserting yields is the id inserted or the list's.

idris.name: ldtl_6_1__interleaved
idris.note: The witness's deadline table: four mints of two kinds, whose deadlines interleave.

idris.name: ldtl_6_1__interleaved_order
idris.note: Two schemas whose deadlines interleave, with two facts sharing a deadline: the order is by deadline, then entry, and differs from entry order and from an order by schema.

idris.name: ldtl_6_1__order
idris.note: THE EXPIRY ORDER of the default mode: by deadline, earliest first, and facts that share a deadline by when each entered working memory ([LDET.5.11]). A stable sort by deadline of the expired ids, which `iret_19_3__expired` yields in the deadline table's order: rows are appended as facts are minted, so that order is entry order. Established for the witness's table by `ldtl_6_1__interleaved_order`; no general theorem states sortedness or stability.

idris.name: ldtl_6_1__order_back
idris.note: Every expired id is in the order: it is a permutation.

idris.name: ldtl_6_1__order_fwd
idris.note: Every id the order yields was expired.

idris.name: ldtl_6_1__place
idris.note: Place an id before the first whose deadline is the same or later, or after this one.

idris.name: ldtl_6_1__place_fwd
idris.note: What placing yields is the id placed or the list's.

idris.name: ldtl_6_1__retract_order
idris.note: BOTH SIDES EXPIRE THE SAME FACTS: retracting the expired ids in [LDTL.6.1]'s order removes exactly what Rete/TtlSweep.idr's batch removes. The order is visible only in the sequence of retractions -- the FACT_RETRACT events of [NFCT.5.4] -- since any order ends in the same state.

idris.name: ldtl_6_1__two_ttls
idris.note: The witness's TTL table: kind 0's TTL is 5, kind 1's is 7.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_3__sweep_net
idris.note: THE SWEEP ON THE NETWORK: every live fact whose deadline is at or before the clock retracted one at a time through alpha dispatch -- [IRET.19.3] step 2, `ds_rete_wm_retract` per fact -- in [LDTL.6.1]'s order, then the cascade.
